Class AbstractPropertyResolver

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.core.env.AbstractPropertyResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConfigurablePropertyResolver, PropertyResolver
Direct Known Subclasses:
PropertySourcesPropertyResolver
public abstract class AbstractPropertyResolver extends Object implements ConfigurablePropertyResolver
用于针对任何底层源解析属性的抽象基类。
Since:
3.1
Author:
Chris Beams, Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen

  • 字段详情

    • DEFAULT_PLACEHOLDER_ESCAPE_CHARACTER_PROPERTY_NAME

      public static final String DEFAULT_PLACEHOLDER_ESCAPE_CHARACTER_PROPERTY_NAME
      JVM system property used to change the default escape character for property placeholder support: "spring.placeholder.escapeCharacter.default".

      要配置自定义转义字符，请提供一个包含单个字符（不同于Character.MIN_VALUE）的字符串。例如，通过命令行提供以下 JVM 系统属性会将默认转义字符设置为'@'。

      -Dspring.placeholder.escapeCharacter.default=@

      要禁用转义字符支持，请将值设置为空字符串——例如，通过命令行提供以下 JVM 系统属性。

      -Dspring.placeholder.escapeCharacter.default=

      如果未设置该属性，将使用 `'\'` 作为默认转义字符。

      也可通过类路径根目录下的 `spring.properties` 文件进行配置。

      Since:
      6.2.7
      See Also:
      • getDefaultEscapeCharacter()
      • Constant Field Values

    • getConversionService

      public ConfigurableConversionService getConversionService()
      描述从接口复制：ConfigurablePropertyResolver
      Return the ConfigurableConversionService used when performing type conversions on properties.

      返回的转换服务的可配置特性允许方便地添加和移除单个Converter实例：

      ConfigurableConversionService cs = env.getConversionService();
cs.addConverter(new FooConverter());
      Specified by:
      `getConversionService` 接口 `ConfigurablePropertyResolver` 中
      See Also:
      • PropertyResolver.getProperty(String, Class)
      • ConverterRegistry.addConverter(Converter)

    • setIgnoreUnresolvableNestedPlaceholders

      public void setIgnoreUnresolvableNestedPlaceholders(boolean ignoreUnresolvableNestedPlaceholders)
      Set whether to throw an exception when encountering an unresolvable placeholder nested within the value of a given property. A false value indicates strict resolution, i.e. that an exception will be thrown. A true value indicates that unresolvable nested placeholders should be passed through in their unresolved ${...} form.

      默认值为false。

      Specified by:
      `setIgnoreUnresolvableNestedPlaceholders` 接口 `ConfigurablePropertyResolver`
      Since:
      3.2

    • resolveNestedPlaceholders

      protected String resolveNestedPlaceholders(String value)
      Resolve placeholders within the given string, deferring to the value of setIgnoreUnresolvableNestedPlaceholders(boolean) to determine whether any unresolvable placeholders should raise an exception or be ignored.

      由 `getProperty(String)` 及其变体调用，隐式解析嵌套占位符。相比之下，`resolvePlaceholders(String)` 和 `resolveRequiredPlaceholders(String)` 不会 委托给此方法，而是根据各自方法的定义，自行处理无法解析的占位符。

      Since:
      3.2
      See Also:
      • setIgnoreUnresolvableNestedPlaceholders(boolean)

    • getDefaultEscapeCharacter

      public static @Nullable Character getDefaultEscapeCharacter() throws IllegalArgumentException
      Get the default escape character to use when parsing strings for property placeholder resolution.

      此方法尝试通过 `"spring.placeholder.escapeCharacter.default"` JVM 系统属性或 Spring 属性获取配置的默认转义字符。

      如果未设置该属性，则回退到'\'。

      Returns:
      配置的默认转义字符，如果已禁用转义字符支持则为 `null`，如果未设置该属性则为 `'\'`。
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - 如果属性配置了无效值，例如 Character.MIN_VALUE 或包含多个字符的字符串
      Since:
      6.2.7
      See Also:
      • DEFAULT_PLACEHOLDER_ESCAPE_CHARACTER_PROPERTY_NAME
      • SystemPropertyUtils.ESCAPE_CHARACTER
